notes: Stop names are the engraving. The Organ Type piston switches between American Classic, American Eclectic and American Symphonic voices (same names). Orchestral Trumpet / Orchestral Oboe tabs can also be set to MIDI A / MIDI B for an external module.
MIDI channels (default): Great 1, Swell 2, Pedal 3, stops on 12. This MIDI scheme is unlike other Rodgers organs (same as Johannus organs).

Stops send Program Changes on channel 12, but the manual only says the numbers "depend on the number of stops and the sequence of stops" - no table is published, so stops are left unbound: use Learn every stop.

Expression (CC11, values 55-127) and general volume (CC7, values 40-127) are documented, but the manual does not say which channel they are sent on; the channels used here are an assumption (expression on each shoe's division channel, volume on channel 1). Check on your organ.
Holding the 0 (general cancel) piston sends the documented 'all stops off' SysEx F0 00 4A 4F 48 41 53 7F F7 (also recognised).
